98060241.s: A bakery serving fresh breakfast sandwiches and distinctive pastries in a simple, stylish setting. A bakery. Open 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
98060241.b: TF Bakery serves fresh breakfast sandwiches and distinctive pastries in a simple, stylish setting, and is known for its French herb omelette on sourdough and its blueberry and cream croissant. Its daily coffee is excellent, and although the indoor seating area is small, the quality of the food more than makes up for it. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.

98060239.s: A small bakery serving high-quality pastries and desserts with warm, homey service. A bakery. Open 9:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98060239.b: House of Novels is a small bakery serving high-quality pastries and desserts with warm, homey service, and it has near-perfect reviews from its visitors. It is known for reasonable prices and for the great care taken in preparing every item, and is a hidden gem worth discovering for lovers of fine desserts. Contact: 0511048069. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
98060239.a: Al Abbas Bin Abdul Muttalib, Al Izdihar, Riyadh 12486

98060238.s: A bakery and cafe with a tasty breakfast menu alongside fresh pastries and croissants. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 11:55 p.m.
98060238.b: Los Primos Bakery & Cafe is a bakery and cafe with a tasty breakfast menu alongside fresh pastries and croissants, and is known for its club sandwich and halloumi croissant. It combines a cafe and a bakery in one calm space, with polished, relaxed service from the staff. Contact: 0554576000. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98060238.a: Muhammad Al Muqaddami St, Al Ghadir, Riyadh 13311

98060237.s: A bakery with a great atmosphere, serving coffee and delicious pastries. A bakery. Open 6:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m.
98060237.b: Part Bakery is a bakery with a great atmosphere, serving coffee and delicious pastries. Its lively setting suits studying and sitting for long periods. It has good reviews for the quality of its coffee and light desserts, and creative wall decor adds a distinctive artistic touch. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98060237.a: Salim Ibn Maqil, An Nakheel, Riyadh 12392

98060236.s: A bakery serving a tasty menu of baked goods and distinctive coffee in an attractive, artistic setting. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98060236.b: Pistrina Bakery serves a tasty menu of baked goods and distinctive coffee in an attractive artistic setting, with traditional baking tools and wavy fabric on the ceiling. It is known for its pecan pastry wheel and its light, crispy cheese and honey wheel, and has excellent reviews for the unique flavor of its coffee. Contact: 0534554148. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
98060236.a: Abi Bakr As Siddiq Rd, Al Yasmeen, Riyadh 13315

98060235.s: A well-known Lebanese bakery offering a wide range of high-quality breads, pastries and cakes. A bakery. Open 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98060235.b: Wooden Bakery is a well-known Lebanese bakery offering a wide range of high-quality breads, pastries and cakes, and is known for its croissants, cheeses, cold cuts and olives. It stands out for its high standard of cleanliness and variety of healthy products, and with several branches it is one of the most trusted and widespread bakeries in Riyadh. Contact: 0501338321. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
98060235.a: Salah Ad Din Al Ayyubi Rd, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh 12233

98058453.s: A distinctive bakery specializing in a variety of pastries and coffees. A bakery. Open 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058453.b: Le Pain Bakery is a distinctive bakery specializing in a variety of pastries and coffees, and by its customers' account it is one of the best bakeries in Riyadh. It is known for croissants in small and large sizes, Danish pastries and pecan pastries, along with a wide selection of cakes by the slice or whole. Contact: 0557252524. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98058453.a: Prince Muhammad Ibn Saad Ibn Abdulaziz Rd, Al Malqa, Riyadh 13521

98058452.s: A bakery making a delicious mix of creative desserts and pastries. A bakery. Open 9:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058452.b: Lilou Artisan Patisserie is a bakery that makes a delicious mix of creative desserts and pastries, and is famous internationally for its mango cake and pistachio concerto. It brings an elegant Parisian touch to its design and presentation, and is one of the finest French patisseries in Riyadh, although its prices are relatively high. Contact: 920000746. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058452.a: Prince Abdulaziz Ibn Musaid Ibn Jalawi St, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12221

98058451.s: A specialty cafe known for its coffee and delicious baked goods. A bakery. Open 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058451.b: Bex is a specialty cafe known for its coffee and delicious baked goods, in a prime location inside King Khalid International Airport. It is known for its latte and distinctive matcha, and its friendly service suits travelers looking for a coffee break before a flight. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.

98058449.s: Fresh, tasty baked goods in a great spot for takeaway or sitting in. A bakery. Open 6:10 a.m. to 11:50 p.m.
98058449.b: Bakery Portal serves fresh, tasty baked goods in a great spot for takeaway or sitting in, and is known for its halloumi and egg croissant and its egg sandwich. It has excellent reviews for the quality of its classic croissant, custard-filled croissant, and Danish with berries and vanilla. Contact: 0555484422. Open from 7:10 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.

98058448.s: A bakery making unique baked goods and offering a wide range of distinctive options. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058448.b: KAYU is a bakery that makes unique baked goods and offers a wide range of distinctive options, and is known for its chocolate mousse and caramel pecan tart. It also serves strawberry and vanilla matcha drinks, and has comfortable indoor and outdoor seating suited to quiet gatherings with friends. Contact: 0505691212. Open from 7:30 a.m. to 12:30 a.m.
98058448.a: Al Dabab Street, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh 12243

98058429.s: Serves fresh products made with natural yeast and expertly baked. A bakery. Open 6:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058429.b: Breddy serves fresh products made with natural yeast and expertly baked, and is known for its cream-filled qatayef, considered among the best, even compared with those of Jordan, Egypt and Palestine. It is also known for sourdough bread, grilled cheese sandwiches and Swedish chocolate rolls, and has very high reviews despite being somewhat expensive. Contact: 0551465554. Open from 6:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98058391.s: A bakery offering a variety of perfectly flaky pastries. A bakery. Open 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058391.b: The Mill Bakery offers a variety of perfectly flaky pastries, and is known for its many types of croissants (7 to 8 kinds) filled with chocolate and nuts. It is also known for its whole wheat bagel and Danish with feta cheese, and has friendly service, although there can be some waiting at peak times. Contact: 0534114058. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058391.a: Al-Imam Ahmad Bin Hanbal St, Al Manar, Riyadh 14222

98058390.s: A bakery specializing in Italian pastries, with an elegant interior design. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 8:30 p.m.
98058390.b: Vittoria's Bakery specializes in Italian pastries and has an elegant interior design. It is known for its chocolate croissant, focaccia and authentic Italian pizza. It has a calm atmosphere with soft music that suits a morning breakfast or an evening coffee, and excellent reviews for its coffee quality and authentic taste. Contact: 0554603344. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:30 p.m.
98058390.a: Saeed Bin Zaid Rd, Qurtubah, Riyadh 13248

98058388.s: A popular bakery specializing in desserts and coffee. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058388.b: Crumble Bake House is a popular bakery specializing in desserts and coffee, and is known for its high-quality cookies and a variety of cakes. Visitors rate it very highly for the quality and cleanliness of the place and its comfortable, spacious interior. Contact: 0550309046. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 1:30 a.m.
98058388.a: Muhammad Ibn Ismail As Sanaani, Al Khaleej, Riyadh 13224

98058387.s: A bakery known for cakes and a wide variety of baked goods. A bakery. Open 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058387.b: Een is a bakery known for cakes and a wide variety of baked goods, and is famous for its mango and pistachio cake and croissant sandwiches with more than 20 filling options. It is a trusted place to order custom birthday cakes, although some visitors note that prices are high for the portion size. Contact: 0532118866. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98058386.s: A bakery specializing in bundt cakes, with a bundt for every occasion. A bakery. Open 8:30 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058386.b: Bundt Bakery specializes in bundt cakes, with a bundt to suit every occasion, and is known for its cardamom and saffron cake and its date tart with coconut. It has a calm, relaxing atmosphere where you can watch the baking process live, and friendly service that sometimes adds free cookies. Contact: 0554504542. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058386.a: Abi Bakr As Siddiq Rd, An Nada, Riyadh 13317

98058384.s: An award winner for best bakery in Riyadh, offering truly unique flavors. A bakery. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058384.b: Easy Bakery has won the award for best bakery in Riyadh and offers truly unique flavors. It is known for consistent coffee and pastry quality across its branches. Prices are reasonable, although some branches could improve their table arrangement to enhance the seating experience. Contact: 0537128003. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98058384.a: Prince Saud Bin Faisal, Al Malqa, Riyadh 13523

98058383.s: A local bakery offering a selection of creative sweet and savory pastries. A bakery. Open 9:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058383.b: Dooka is a local bakery offering a selection of creative sweet and savory pastries, and is known for its Nutella-filled crepe and chocolate donuts. It offers a cup of coffee with a piece of chocolate as a welcome gift, and has stylish decor that suits evening gatherings with friends. Contact: 0531699919. Open from 9:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98058383.a: Uthman Ibn Affan Rd, Al Mughrizat, Riyadh 12483

98058378.s: Home to a large group of luxury international brands. A shopping center. Open 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98058378.b: Centria Mall is one of the most elegant and quietest malls in Riyadh, located on the famous Olaya Street in the heart of the city's most upscale districts. It houses a large group of luxury international fashion and jewelry brands, and offers a refined, exclusive shopping experience away from the crowds typical of the big malls. It has cafes and a distinctive Japanese restaurant, and its elegant interior design gives it an exclusive feel that suits lovers of high-end brands. Contact: 0112161111. Open from 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.

98058377.s: Close to the airport, with many shops and restaurants for an enjoyable shopping experience. A shopping center. Open 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058377.b: Park Avenue Mall is a quiet family shopping center in the Qurtubah district of east Riyadh. It is close to the airport and suits shopping away from the crowds. It has a variety of shops, restaurants and cafes, as well as the largest food court, suited to different family tastes, and play and entertainment areas for children. It has an elegant design and large parking areas (ground level and basement), and is a relatively quiet family destination compared with the city's busier malls. Open from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98058377.a: Saeed Ibn Zaid Rd, Qurtubah, Riyadh 13248

98058376.s: A skyscraper with a distinctive selection of luxury international brands and unique restaurants, and an observation deck at the top of the tower. A shopping center. Open 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058376.b: Al Faisaliah Tower is one of the oldest and most famous architectural landmarks in Riyadh. It opened in 2000 and is known for its distinctive pyramid-shaped design, topped by a giant golden glass sphere 24 meters high. It was the first true skyscraper in the Kingdom and a visual symbol of the Riyadh skyline. The tower houses the luxury Four Seasons Hotel and the Al Faisaliah shopping center, which hosts top international fashion and jewelry brands, as well as a group of upscale restaurants and cafes. Its highlight is the observation deck inside the golden sphere at the top, which offers a stunning panoramic view of Riyadh from a great height. Entry tickets cost around SAR 69 to 115 depending on the package, and it is one of the best places to watch the sun set over the city. Open from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98058376.a: King Fahd Rd, Al Olaya, Riyadh 30194

98058373.s: The View Mall is one of the notable shopping centers in north Riyadh, strategically located on King Abdulaziz Road. A shopping center.
98058373.b: The View Mall is one of the notable shopping centers in north Riyadh, strategically located on King Abdulaziz Road. The mall has a wide selection of international fashion, electronics and perfume stores, along with a cinema equipped with the latest screens and a comfortable shopping experience for families. It has an elegant, clean interior design and large air-conditioned spaces, and encouraging reviews for how easy it is to move between its floors. Parking is available (two hours free, then SAR 10 for each additional hour). Contact: 920000262. Open from 9:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98058372.s: Kingdom Centre is one of the most prominent architectural landmarks in Riyadh and the Kingdom, with a unique inverted-arch design about 302 meters (99 floors) tall. A shopping center.
98058372.b: Kingdom Centre is one of the most prominent architectural landmarks in Riyadh and the Kingdom. It has a unique inverted-arch design and stands about 302 meters (99 floors) tall, making it one of the tallest towers in the city. The tower houses a luxury shopping center with top international fashion, jewelry and perfume brands, as well as the "Royal Floor" center, reserved entirely for women on one of its upper floors, and a group of upscale restaurants and cafes. The tower's best-known feature is the famous Sky Bridge on the 99th floor, which offers a stunning glass-enclosed panoramic view of the whole of Riyadh from a great height. It is one of the most popular spots for taking photos, especially at sunset when the city lights begin to sparkle. A Four Seasons hotel and luxury residential apartments are also located inside the tower. Contact: 0112112222. Open from 9:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058372.a: King Fahd Rd, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12214

98058318.s: One of the best traditional places for antiques and gifts, with many other goods besides. A traditional market. Open 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058318.b: Al Suwailem Street is one of the best traditional places in Riyadh for antiques and gifts, with many other goods besides, and is known for home decor items and Indian antiques. It sells decorative pieces, gifts, boxes, furnishings, incense burners, wooden toys and unique mirrors, and offers home delivery to make shopping easier. Contact: 0557314917. Open from 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.
98058318.a: Al Sulaim St, Ad Dirah, Riyadh 12633
